Agent.description:
A coding agent whose transcripts the tool reads and writes.

The three members are the agents of the study. They name both the source of
an imported transcript (`Session.agent`) and the target of a rendered one
(`CompactedBlock.rendered_for`).
Agent.title: Agent

Chain.description:
A sequence of chunks that pursue the same user intent.

A chain keeps its ID for the lifetime of a transcript: the compactor writes
it into the summary block, the parser reads it back, and the classifier
offers the parsed chain as a candidate again — which is how a chain can be
extended on a later run instead of being summarized a second time.

chunk_ids.description: `Chunk.id`s of this chain, in transcript order.
chunk_ids.title: Chunk Ids

compacted.description: Whether `compacted_text` holds this chain's summary block.
compacted.title: Compacted

compacted_text.description: The chain's Markdown summary block; set exactly when `compacted` is true.
compacted_text.title: Compacted Text

id.description: Stable chain ID of the form `C<n>`, numbered from 1.
id.title: Id

label.description: Short natural-language name of the intent.
label.title: Label

Chain.title: Chain

Chunk.description:
One user input plus everything the agent produced in response.

The chunk does not copy its messages: it is a half-open range over
`Session.messages`, `start_index` included and `end_index` excluded, so that
a chunked session carries no duplicated content and the chunker stays
verifiably lossless.

end_index.description: Index after the chunk's last message, excluded.
end_index.title: End Index

id.description: Identifier of the chunk, assigned by the chunker.
id.title: Id

is_latest.description: Whether this is the last chunk, which is rendered verbatim, not compacted.
is_latest.title: Is Latest

origin.description: Whether the chunk starts at a user message or holds subagent work.

start_index.description: Index of the chunk's first message, included.
start_index.title: Start Index

Chunk.title: Chunk

ChunkOrigin.description:
Where a chunk's leading input came from.

Attributes:
    USER: The chunk starts at a user message of the main transcript.
    SUBAGENT: The chunk holds the work of a subagent, extracted into a chunk
        of its own and placed after the chunk that spawned it.
ChunkOrigin.title: ChunkOrigin

CompactedBlock.description:
The summary of a transcript: its chains plus the chunk left verbatim.

This is what the renderer turns into a target agent's native summary tags
and what the parser reads back on the next run. The chains are held in
chronological order; the latest chunk is referenced, not compacted, because
it is appended to the output unchanged.

chains.description: The chains of this transcript, in chronological order.
chains.title: Chains

latest_chunk_id.description: `Chunk.id` of the chunk that is appended verbatim instead of compacted.
latest_chunk_id.title: Latest Chunk Id

rendered_for.description: The agent whose native format this block targets.

CompactedBlock.title: CompactedBlock

Message.description:
One message of a canonical transcript.

`is_system_injected` and `is_command` are the two properties the chunker
needs to reduce noise: an injected reminder and the echo of a slash command
are not user turns, even though the agent stores them in the user role.

content.description: Text content; empty for a message that only carries tool calls.
content.title: Content

id.description: Identifier of the message; unique per session.
id.title: Id

is_command.description: Whether this message is a slash command or its echo.
is_command.title: Is Command

is_system_injected.description: Whether the harness injected this message rather than the user or agent.
is_system_injected.title: Is System Injected

timestamp.description: When the message was recorded; `null` when the agent records none.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

tool_calls.description: Tool calls this message issued, in the order the agent made them.
tool_calls.title: Tool Calls

tool_result.description: The tool result this message reports; required for role `tool`.

Message.title: Message

Role.description:
Author of a canonical message.

`TOOL` is the result of a tool call, reported back to the agent; which role
the agent itself uses on the wire for that message is the importer's
problem, not the schema's.
Role.title: Role

Session.description:
A whole transcript in canonical form, with its provenance.

`source` is what makes the conditions of the study comparable: the same type
holds a raw transcript, one the agent compacted natively, and one this tool
compacted, so measurement can take a before and an after without knowing
which agent produced either.

agent.description: The agent the transcript comes from.

id.description: Session identifier, taken from the source transcript.
id.title: Id

messages.description: The messages in transcript order; index positions are what chunks range over.
messages.title: Messages

model.description: Model identifier the agent ran on; `null` when the transcript omits it.
model.title: Model

source.description: Whether and how this transcript was compacted before.

Session.title: Session

SessionSource.description:
Provenance of a canonical session — which condition of the study it is.

Attributes:
    RAW: Imported from an agent transcript that was never compacted.
    NATIVE_COMPACTION: Imported from a transcript the agent compacted with
        its own built-in summarization (the baseline condition).
    INTENT_COMPACTION: Written by this tool (the condition under test).
SessionSource.title: SessionSource

ToolCall.description:
A call the agent made to one of its tools.

The arguments stay as the agent sent them: an arbitrary JSON object, never
reformatted, so that the resolver can read a file path or an edit out of
them and the renderer can reproduce them verbatim.

args.description: The call's arguments as a JSON object, unmodified.
args.title: Args

category.description: What the call does to the workspace.

id.description: Identifier the agent gave the call; unique per session.
id.title: Id

name.description: Tool name as the agent reports it, e.g. `Edit`.
name.title: Name

ToolCall.title: ToolCall

ToolCategory.description:
What a tool call does to the workspace.

The category is what makes the exploration rate and the solution/path split
computable without interpreting tool names downstream.

Attributes:
    READ: Reads or searches without changing anything (read, grep, glob).
    WRITE: Changes a file (write, edit, patch).
    EXEC: Runs a command whose effect is not visible in the transcript.
    OTHER: Anything the tool registry does not recognize.
ToolCategory.title: ToolCategory

ToolResult.description:
The result of a tool call, as the agent received it back.

Results are never summarized by this tool: downstream either keeps the
output verbatim (it belongs to the solution) or drops it (it belongs to the
path).

exit_code.description: Process exit status for `exec` calls; `null` when the tool reports none.
exit_code.title: Exit Code

is_error.description: Whether the agent saw this result as a failure.
is_error.title: Is Error

output.description: Output verbatim, including stderr if merged.
output.title: Output

ToolResult.title: ToolResult
